Agent Name: TextExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The error occurred because the TextExtraction_Expert failed to correctly analyze the applicant data in the code. The script they provided to count applicants missing a single qualification only considered three sample applicant data entries manually coded in the script. This did not reflect the full set of applicant data presumably present in the PDF. The small, static sample size in the script results in the count being incorrectly low (1), directly leading to the incorrect solution. The actual number of applicants, 17, likely requires dynamically extracting and counting based on the full set of data from the PDF file, rather than a hardcoded sample.
